timing_scopes: wall clock: prepared CPU tokens to GPU, mask, and encoder; excludes tokenization

long_evidence.primary_endpoint: intact/full/8192 F1; equal-weight language and evidence position
long_evidence.primary_sample_rule: use variant-matched available source groups within each language/position cell; equal-weight the six cell means; report cell coverage and complete-case sensitivity
long_evidence.resampling_unit: source article group; paired across variants
long_evidence.resampling_rule: one union-of-source-groups draw per language shared across positions and variants; normalize within each available position
long_evidence.evidence_deleted_endpoint: original-answer exact-match repetition rate; not refusal accuracy
long_evidence.scope: controlled synthetic Wikipedia background with heldout QA evidence; not natural long-document or multi-hop QA
long_evidence.scheduling: four independent evaluation processes on GPU7; finish before encoder timing

analysis.cost_quality_comparison: per-task and per-input-length tradeoffs; report effect sizes and uncertainty
analysis.training_cost: existing matching-batch calibration and actual resource accounting; do not compare contended worker wall times as architecture speed
